question: A group of 6 college students with multiple sclerosis (MS) was evaluated for flares in a neurology clinic. The results are shown in the figure. Each row represents a patient. The gray bars represent the duration of the flare. The arrowheads indicate that disease was already present before and/or persisted beyond the timeframe of the study. Based on the figure, which of the following is the most valid statement about MS flares in this group of students?

options.opa: Incidence from April 1st to June 1st was 3
options.opb: Incidence during the month of May was 2
options.opc: Incidence during the month of February was 3
options.ope: Prevalence of the disease on May 15 was 4/6

analysis: The figure shows the duration of flares in 6 college students with MS. The arrows indicate that the disease was present before and/or persisted beyond the study timeframe. Based on the figure, the most valid statement is that the incidence during the month of May was 2.
